basic_info.description: Stunning Modern Loft - Top Floor, Corner Unit with High Ceilings & Abundant Natural Light. This sleek, contemporary, spacious 1BR,1.5BA loft perfectly blends style and functionality. Featuring soaring high ceilings and expansive windows with custom shades, sky windows offer plenty of natural light, creating an airy & inviting atmosphere. A living room w/ a fireplace, polished hardwood floor, industrial steel staircase, & custom lighting offers a cozy feeling, including a modern kitchen w/ appliances, in-unit W/D, while the additional half-bath provides extra convenience for guests. The upstairs primary carpeted suite offers privacy, ample closet space, and an en-suite bath. This property has 1 extra storage,1 pkg space, & a 24/7 security door & Rooftop access. Shipley is a quiet street centrally situated in a vibrant and conveniently accessible to Freeway 280, 101 & 80 to East Bay & Peninsula, downtown shopping center, Union Square, Moscone Center, Modern Art Museum, movie theatre, Whole Foods, Safeway, Trader Joe, gyms, banks, restaurants, Oracle Park, Chase Center, Mission Bay, public transportation such as Caltrain, Bart, Muni, Bus, Cable Car, & much more.
